offers.note: SAEMES documents a 0.50 EUR service fee plus 0.50 EUR/kWh for direct QR/CB charging. Its 2026 parking guide states 10 EUR/hour after 15 consecutive hours connected; this is modeled as a connection-duration surcharge, not as car-park parking cost.

notes: Tariffs through mobility-provider badges can differ and must remain separate roaming offers.
Parking charges for the car park are not part of this charging offer.
Rapid Electra stations hosted inside some SAEMES car parks are not covered by this SAEMES direct rule when the resolved tariff network is Electra.
